# Release Notes

## CI/CD & Infrastructure
- **#1951**: Pointed boundary validation at omnibase_core and bound AC2 to a test that fails at the merge base.
- **#1667**: Bumped the actions group with 2 updates.
- **#1321**: Bumped the actions group with 3 updates.
- **#1579**: Routed same-repo PRs to self-hosted runners in validate-docs to avoid internal PyPI mirror DNS errors.
- **#1028**: Standardized core workflow runner routing and isolated self-hosted CI temp paths.
- **#1016**: Added call-reject-skip.yml caller for merge_group skip-token re-scan.
- **#1577**: Release sync-main now pushes as onexbot-occ-writer app identity.
- **#3786**: Omnimarket's pr-title check now runs omnimarket's node.
- **#2920**: Scoped local pre-commit validators to staged files.

## Core Refactoring & Governance
- **#1361**: Logged silent exception catch in MixinContractPublisher heartbeat loop.
- **#1014**: Added HANDOFF_NUDGE bit to EnumHookBit.
- **#257**: Relocated stray topic literals into SPI event registry.
- **#170**: Moved ProtocolDomainPlugin to omnibase_spi.
- **#1337**: Required event_model on command-category handler_routing entries.
- **#1253**: Removed dead onex.runtime.intents hardcoded topic and dead intent-publisher path.
- **#123**: Removed consul protocol references and regenerated snapshot.
- **#1471**: Consolidated to a single canonical ProtocolSemVer.

## Feature Enhancements
- **#3767**: Replaced I9 prompt with code task and added Layer-1 test.
- **#3674**: Throughput tick node names a long park, an unread host, a lane that never ran and a rising open count.
- **#3728**: Added typed gateway reads for Actions, PR text and releases.
- **#3736**: Host observer reports launchd, cron and receipts runs on the bus.
- **#3563**: node_dod_verify names contract_in_another_repo.
- **#3810**: Throughput tick reports Codex headroom of a Claude-limited host.
- **#3275**: Attempt record accepts and drops six forthcoming attempt lineage keys.
- **#3739**: dod_verify refuses evidence bound to criteria the ticket no longer carries.
- **#3417**: Recorded the alert-channel liveness verdict in a projection.
- **#2980**: Added companion seam for the PR landing workflow.

## Bug Fixes
- **#3815**: Rebase pushes only the PR head ref; polish dispatch runs off the kernel loop.
- **#2900**: Deploy effect publishes the rebuild command and returns to avoid dispatch deadline.
